function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values, and the data dictionary confirms that patients can be re-tested, resulting in multiple rows per patient (with `sample_seq` indicating the assay run). The row with the highest `sample_seq` should be kept for each patient.", "implication": "If we compute the mean of `biomarker_final` across all rows, we will double-weight the 24 patients who were re-tested (since each appears twice, and one of those rows has higher `sample_seq`). This would bias the mean. We must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient, before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
